card.line: Edom was a rugged, mountainous land south of the Dead Sea, home to Israel's "brother" nation, and a place of refusal, war, and rebellion against Israel and Judah.

moments.title: Edom Says No to Israel
moments.text: Moses sent messengers asking the king of Edom to let Israel pass along the King's Highway. Edom refused and came out with a large army, so Israel turned away.

moments.title: David Rules Edom
moments.text: David struck down eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt. He placed garrisons throughout Edom, and the Edomites became subject to him.

moments.title: Hadad Rises Against Solomon
moments.text: The LORD raised up Hadad the Edomite as an adversary to Solomon. Earlier, Joab had struck down every male in Edom, and young Hadad had fled to Egypt.

moments.title: Water Comes from Edom
moments.text: Three kings traveled through the Desert of Edom and ran out of water. Elisha spoke the LORD's word, and the next morning water flowed from the direction of Edom and filled the land.

moments.title: Edom Rebels Against Judah
moments.text: In the days of Jehoram, Edom rebelled against Judah and appointed its own king. The writer says Edom has been in rebellion to this day.
